description: Australian Ports is a dataset listed in Australian Government open data portal (data.gov.au), an open data portal, published or maintained by Australian Customs and Border Protection Service. Within this dataset are Australia-C/s ports commonly used by cruise vessels. Each port is categorised according to a set of stringent guidelines, and may have restrictions on use applied. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Australian Customs and Border Protection Service. Its tags are australia, customs, googlefusiontables, maritime, ports. It offers 2 resource(s) in plain, xls. The portal shows 2025-03-04 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
